messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick capture from BrightMap call — pulling feature asks and risks into one thread so product/eng can triage. TL;DR: 3 asks + a bug (embeddings mismatch). Renewal 2026-04-20, trial now; cost transparency is blocking.
Marta (Product): Thanks Aisha. Can you list the 3 asks + which is blocking renewal? Any repro/artifacts?
Aisha (CS): Sure. Short list:
- Ask 1 (BLOCKER): per-route cost breakdown in Console + CSV export (they need to justify spend to finance)
- Ask 2 (PAID): team-level prompt presets / sticky prompts
- Ask 3 (NICHE): ability to pin/lock model version per-route for testing
Bug: embeddings mismatch across routes — duplicates & low similarity where they expect distinct vectors. Attached mini log and screenshot: https://files.redwood/bmap/screen123.png
Devon (CS): Also mentioned latency spikes when switching to Dedicated capacity. Sent telemetry to eng-sre (trace id 0x7f3a). Could be batching config.
Priya (Solutions): For per-route cost export: do they need raw rate card or aggregated costs? There may be PCI/data exposure concerns if we export line-item usage.
Aisha (CS): They want aggregated per-route + per-model usage, plus CSV that maps tokens->cost. No raw provider rates. Emphasized internal finance review needs a single spreadsheet.
Elliot (PM): I'll triage. Plan: create tickets, label 'cs:customer-ask' and 'renewal-risk'. Tentative priority: P0 for cost breakdown, P1 for presets, P2 for pin toggle. Need eng estimates.
ProductBot: Ticket INF-1427 created by Elliot for "BrightMap — per-route cost export". Link: https://tracker.redwood/INF-1427
Aisha (CS): BrightMap also requested a short-term workaround: an export of aggregated daily cost via Support until product solution ships. They said that would buy 4–6 weeks.
Marta (Product): OK. Dev/eng estimate needed for INF-1427. Priya — can you sketch a UX that hides provider rate details but gives per-route totals + CSV headers? Devon — can you capture the embedding repro in a notebook for SRE/ML to debug?
Priya (Solutions): On it — I'll drop a quick mock and CSV column spec by EOD. Will add a security note: confirm no PII/PCI in CSV. Tagging security for review.
Devon (CS): I'll produce a minimal repro notebook and example vectors. Will post to the feature doc and ping eng-ml.
Elliot (PM): Creating follow-up ticket INF-1428 for "model pin toggle" (low effort). Assigning to Marta for scope. Added a checklist: security review, CS support export, UX mock.
ProductBot: Ticket INF-1428 created by Elliot for "Model pin toggle (BrightMap)". Link: https://tracker.redwood/INF-1428
Aisha (CS): Can we get initial estimate for INF-1427 by Friday? I have a follow-up call with BrightMap next Tue 10am PT and want to report next steps.
Marta (Product): Aiming to have engineering estimates by Thu COB. Will update INF-1427 with rough T-shirt size + risks. :+1:
Devon (CS): Note — embedding mismatch might be caused by route-level preprocessing differences. I'll include the preprocess diff in the notebook.
Aisha (CS): Perfect. I'll schedule the follow-up and share the invite. Thanks team — tagging @Marta @Elliot @Priya @Devon. If anyone needs extra context, DM me or add comments on INF-1427.
Marta (Product): Thanks Aisha, will follow up here when mocks/estimates are in.
Priya (Solutions): Mock incoming by 5pm. Will include CSV sample and security questions.
Aisha (CS): Closing loop for now. Will post meeting notes and customer acceptance criteria after the follow-up. :)
